experiment: C1 confirmatory synthetic concept cohort v3
purpose: Extend the v2 semantic rubric with the v3 anchor, discourse-schedule, exact-title, question-form, and reciprocal-pair checks before any v3 text exists.

permitted: frozen target concept title and summary
frozen reciprocal hard-negative title and summary
the assigned v3 scenario anchor and discourse role
all six generated requests for the target concept
both six-request batches in the reciprocal pair
the inherited rubric and this addendum
prohibited: the other independent review or any partial judgment from it

additional_document_checks.pass_rule: The request centrally instantiates both the assigned scenario_anchor and its frozen discourse role; changing to an adjacent application or generic concept summary fails.
The request does not quote the anchor as a heading, list item, instruction, dataset label, split label, or meta-description. Natural reuse of necessary generic content words is allowed.
The normalized exact target title and normalized exact reciprocal hard-negative title are both absent from the request.
The text is one English prose paragraph that functions as one user question, ends in a question mark, and contains no answer, list, code, formula block, table, or heading.

additional_concept_batch_checks.pass_rule: In the frozen order, the six requests fulfill causal mechanism, contrastive diagnosis, design tradeoff, failure analysis, counterfactual prediction, and evidence interpretation respectively; no slot is replaced or duplicated.
Every one of the concept's six frozen anchors is realized once and only once, with no merged, omitted, or reassigned scenario.

reciprocal_pair_checks.pass_rule: The two batches are the two frozen reciprocal concepts in the same superdomain and each names the other as its hard negative in the frozen specification.

No request on either side centrally requires, promises, or tests the reciprocal concept as a co-equal goal; contextual adjacency alone is allowed only when the target remains sufficient for the requested explanation.

Both sides realize the same ordered discourse-role schedule with comparable request form and specificity; wording, template, named-entity, code, equation, or repeated-frame shortcuts cannot identify the pair member independently of content.

decision_rule: Every inherited and additional document, concept-batch, and reciprocal-pair check must pass in both independently hash-locked reviews. Any failure or disagreement stops v3 before activation extraction. Generated text is not edited and no document or concept is selectively regenerated.

independence_protocol.aggregation: deterministic conservative conjunction after both review hashes are locked
